---
title: "The Literature Zoo"
subtitle: "Cited Scalars for MFU, Chinchilla, Batch Size, and Communication"
---

The Literature Zoo holds **published anchors** cited in the textbook appendices: MFU bands,
Chinchilla ratios, critical-batch-size anchors, and communication overheads. Every entry is a
`Sourced` scalar with structured `Provenance` (see [Provenance](../provenance.qmd)).

::: {.callout-important}
## Not hardware specs
Do not confuse `Literature.Training.MfuHigh` with a GPU datasheet field. Literature entries
are cited teaching assumptions; silicon numbers live in [`Hardware`](hardware.qmd).
Operational run-overhead profiles live in [`Ops`](ops.qmd), and non-executable scale-efficiency
anchors live in [`ReferenceStats`](scenarios.qmd) (for example `ReferenceStats.TrainingScaleProfiles`);
provenance records the source, while the registry path records the category.
:::

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import mlsysim
from mlsysim.core.provenance import scalar_value

sections = [
    ("Training MFU bands", mlsysim.Literature.Training),
    ("Benchmark anchors", mlsysim.Literature.Benchmarks),
    ("Critical batch size anchors", mlsysim.Literature.BatchSize),
    ("Chinchilla anchors", mlsysim.Literature.Chinchilla),
    ("Communication", mlsysim.Literature.Communication),
    ("Published training runs", mlsysim.Literature.TrainingRuns),
]

for title, reg in sections:
    print(f"### {title}\n")
    print("| Entry | Value | Description |")
    print("|:---|:---:|:---|")
    for item in reg.list():
        if hasattr(item, "provenance"):
            try:
                val = scalar_value(item)
            except TypeError:
                val = f"{item:~P}"
            desc = getattr(item, "description", "") or "---"
            name = getattr(item, "name", type(item).__name__)
        else:
            val = item
            desc = "---"
            name = str(item)
        print(f"| **{name}** | {val} | {desc} |")
    print()

if hasattr(mlsysim.Literature, "KaplanScalingLaws"):
    print("### Kaplan scaling-law exponents (`Literature.KaplanScalingLaws`)\n")
    print("| Key | Value |")
    print("|:---|:---|")
    ksl = mlsysim.Literature.KaplanScalingLaws
    for attr in sorted(dir(ksl)):
        if attr.startswith("_") or attr in ("list", "metadata"):
            continue
        val = getattr(ksl, attr)
        print(f"| `{attr}` | `{val}` |")
    print()
```

## Python Access

```python
import mlsysim

chinchilla_ratio = mlsysim.Literature.Chinchilla.TokensPerParam
mfu_high = mlsysim.Literature.Training.MfuHigh
ring_factor = mlsysim.Literature.Communication.RingAllreduceFactor
```

When calibrating η in [`accuracy.qmd`](../accuracy.qmd), cross-check against these literature
bands before picking solver `efficiency` kwargs.
